title: Tiefenbach-/Rettenbachgletscher: water behind the snow
reuseStatus: Publicly viewable register. No open bulk-data license verified; selected factual case-study transcription, not a claim of an openly licensed database.
crsEvidence: Official tirisMaps linked from the Panorama record uses bboxSR=31254 and imageSR=31254. Checked 2026-11-02; coordinates interpreted as MGI / Austria GK West. No survey-grade positional accuracy claimed.

system.note: This record includes permission deadlines ending in 2025; status does not establish current permit validity. No observed water consumption or cannon inventory is provided.

nodes.name: Speicherteich Panorama
nodes.detail: Recorded usable storage: 416,500 m³. Dam crest: 2,919 m above sea level.

nodes.name: Tiefenbach · southern intake
nodes.detail: Recorded withdrawal permission: 80 l/s and 140,000 m³/year, May–September. A separate first-fill permission is not added to the recurring limit.

nodes.name: Pirchlerbach · western intake
nodes.detail: Recorded withdrawal permission: 80 l/s and 90,000 m³/year, May–September. Subject to residual-flow conditions.

nodes.name: Northern glacier-stream intake
nodes.detail: Recorded withdrawal permission: 12 l/s and 30,000 m³/year, June–August. Three glacier outflow channels.

nodes.name: Eastern intake / Tiefenbachferner II
nodes.originalName: Wasserfassung Ost - Speicherteich Tiefenbachferner, Pumpstation Tiefenbachferner II (Petznerbach)
nodes.detail: Season-dependent permissions: 30 l/s October–April; 80 l/s and 10,000 m³/year May–September. Location is approximately at the withdrawal/pumping station. Nearly coincident with the UV facility.

nodes.name: Tiefenbachferner · UV / pumping facility
nodes.detail: Recorded as Sonderanlage / UV Anlage. Permission: 28 l/s and 8,000 m³ per season, September–December. Nearly coincident with the eastern intake; not an additional reservoir.

nodes.name: Speicherteich Tiefenbachferner
nodes.detail: Recorded usable storage: 7,000 m³. A separate narrative states 9,000 m³ total volume; those are different measures, not interchangeable.

nodes.name: Petznerbach tributary intake
nodes.detail: Permission expressed as at most two thirds of stream flow, rather than a fixed annual volume. Cannot be added directly to m³/year permissions.

nodes.name: Ötztaler Ache intake
nodes.detail: Recorded withdrawal permission: 35 l/s and 50,000 m³/year, September 15–December 31, only outside operating times of the Grünwald system. The register links this intake to the top-level system, which has no separate mapped point in this extract.
